research_height.transfer_path: strictly prior official real-time business-conditions state -> six-component lifecycle economics -> possible later whole-portfolio treatment question

central_question: Does the latest strictly prior real-time Philadelphia Fed ADS business-conditions vintage being above its model-imposed zero baseline identify a materially favorable or adverse state for the frozen six-component portfolio?

why_now.origin: The post-Unit-118 whole-map retained no ready internal mechanism. A source-first audit rejected exact public SII continuation but found an official all-vintages ADS archive with a natural zero and dense causal coverage through 2026-08-27.
why_now.independence: ADS is a real-time coincident business-conditions state derived from six macro indicators. It is not a factor-cap, cooldown, portfolio weight, risk, ladder, stop, exit, occupancy, symbol-split or GSCPI continuation.
why_now.program_1: The broad dual-portfolio internal-formula lattice and its Lab interaction clues are closed and cannot be rescued.
why_now.program_3: Order, clock, session, pending and occupancy paths are closed or confounded and are not implicated by this source.
why_now.program_4: No new causal held-position checkpoint was produced by the source audit.
why_now.program_5: Any later implementation consequence would concern portfolio risk, but this external state must first pass complete economics without opening sizing or allocation.
why_now.program_7: The unit consumes a new official economic object rather than reopening estimator, scale or attribution diagnostics.

official_source.natural_baseline: The model-imposed theoretical average is zero. Positive ADS values indicate better-than-average and negative values worse-than-average real business conditions.
official_source.publication_rule: The official product is updated after new or revised underlying releases about seven to eight times monthly. The MMDDYY date embedded in each ADS_INDEX vintage column is its publication date.
official_source.revision_boundary: Use the official all-vintages workbook. Retain only the last finite daily estimate inside each vintage column; never backfill the currently revised history into an earlier date.
official_source.causal_boundary: A vintage is usable only when its publication date is strictly earlier than the lifecycle server date. Same-day births retain the prior vintage because no intraday release time is assumed.

frozen_state.above_normal: The latest strictly prior official ADS vintage's last finite estimate is greater than zero.
frozen_state.at_or_below_normal: The latest strictly prior official ADS vintage's last finite estimate is less than or equal to zero.
frozen_state.unavailable: No retained official vintage date is strictly earlier than the birth server date.
forbidden_rescues: ADS magnitude, change, persistence, sign-transition, percentile, rolling transform, alternate threshold, lag or same-day activation
component, book, period, year, month, direction, event, symbol, latest-window or 2026-only subgroup
ADS subcomponent, release type, GSCPI reinterpretation, financial-stress, rates, options, metals or another external-series substitution
factor cap, cooldown, stop, exit, sizing, portfolio weight, ladder, occupancy, capital partition or symbol split

outcome_free_feasibility.design_status: All four periods, both books and all six pooled components have both states above the frozen density minima. No descriptive-only period or outcome-dependent correction is needed.

lifecycle_reconstruction.ordering: Concatenate only the six pinned files in declared order and preserve source row order.
lifecycle_reconstruction.birth: OPEN for five market components and PASSIVE_FILL for Passive.
lifecycle_reconstruction.final: The next same-component CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE under strict alternation.
lifecycle_reconstruction.planned_risk: Positive planned_risk parsed from final detail.
lifecycle_reconstruction.stop: One only when final detail reason is DEAL_REASON_SL; otherwise zero for DEAL_REASON_EXPERT.
lifecycle_reconstruction.centered_outcomes: Within each component-period, subtract the all-state mean stressed_r and stop rate. ABOVE_NORMAL minus AT_OR_BELOW_NORMAL centered differences over all four periods are primary.

requirements: All twelve declared source and portfolio byte/hash pins pass.
The causal schedule contains exactly 385 strictly increasing vintage dates from 2022-01-06 through 2026-08-27, each with a finite value and observation date strictly before publication.
The six files contain exactly 16,477 event rows, 2,233 births, 2,027 CLOSE and 206 EXTERNAL_CLOSE finals.
Strict alternation yields exactly 2,233 complete lifecycles, 206 stops, actual net +444.19 USD and 2x-cost stressed net +407.0477 USD.
State mapping yields exactly 1,100 ABOVE_NORMAL, 1,133 AT_OR_BELOW_NORMAL and zero unavailable rows.
Every period-book-state cell has at least 40 lifecycles and every pooled component-state cell has at least 40.

favorable_above_normal: Primary pooled centered stressed_r effect is at least +0.10R.
Primary pooled centered stop-rate effect is at most -0.05.
The concordant favorable direction appears in both books, at least three of four periods and at least four of six components.
No period contributes more than 60 percent and no component more than 45 percent of absolute stressed-R contrast.
adverse_above_normal: Primary pooled centered stressed_r effect is at most -0.10R.
Primary pooled centered stop-rate effect is at least +0.05.
The concordant adverse direction appears in both books, at least three of four periods and at least four of six components.
No period contributes more than 60 percent and no component more than 45 percent of absolute stressed-R contrast.

requirements: Absolute primary pooled centered stressed_r effect is less than 0.05R.
Absolute primary pooled centered stop-rate effect is less than 0.025.
Neither concordant direction appears in more than two periods or more than three components.

decision_translation.favorable_or_adverse: Retain exactly one Lab-only nonautomatic whole-portfolio ADS state question for the next whole-map comparison. This unit alone creates no Optimization candidate, MT5 escalation, sizing rule or Live authority.
decision_translation.no_field_or_ambiguous: Retain no seed and return to the serial Optimization whole-map boundary without same-family rescue.
decision_translation.invalid: Correct source, environment, engineering or design faults before verdict; never relabel them an economic failure.
